name: DP Data Center Debrecen (Galamb utca 1)
developer: Dryvit Profi Kft. / DP Data Center
notes: County-level entry (Hajdu-Bihar): EPS-Connect (2021) reported a unique commercial datacenter under construction in Debrecen's Galamb utca building for Dryvit Profi, designed for direct water cooling and high-density racks; Dryvit Profi's own post covers DP Data Center server-centre build-out; datacenter.hu markets the brand. Current operational status and MW not confirmed in public sources; status per 2021 construction report.

name: BMW Group Plant Debrecen DC1 datacenter optical connection
developer: BMW Hungary Kft. / Invitech ICT Services
notes: County-level entry: NMHH official permit notice CD60532/2023 for the optical connection of BMW Hungary Kft. DC1 datacenter in Debrecen (Hajdu-Bihar) - official A-grade evidence of DC infrastructure inside the BMW plant campus; Invitech reports the optical delivery including the DC1 node. Enterprise/campus infrastructure, not independent colo.

name: Komondor Supercomputer Center (University of Debrecen)
notes: County-level entry: KIFU/University of Debrecen national HPC centre (Kassai Street campus, Debrecen, Hajdu-Bihar) hosts the 5-petaflop Komondor supercomputer (installed summer 2023, max electrical power 500 kW / 0.5 MW). Research/HPC facility.

name: University of Miskolc HPC / supercomputer
notes: 24.hu (2015-10-25) reports the new supercomputer at the University of Miskolc (1.5 TB RAM, 240 TB storage); KIFU HPC history page confirms an HPC machine was commissioned at the University of Miskolc in late 2015. Research/HPC facility in Miskolc city (Borsod-Abauj-Zemplen county); not commercial colocation. MW not disclosed.

name: Giganet Internet Kft. data center / server hosting (Nyiregyhaza)

Regional ISP colocation/hosting facility; no public MW figure. Operator-page evidence B, facility specs limited.

name: KBC Torokbalint enterprise data centre
notes: Cummins case study (2019) describes KBC Bank data-centre infrastructure in Torokbalint, Pest county, with generator redundancy; PEEK (battery-monitoring vendor) LinkedIn post corroborates an operational Torokbalint data center (2,240 batteries monitored). Enterprise/bank facility, not public colo; no MW figure.

name: MVM NET / government datacenter building, God
developer: MVM NET Zrt. / Antenna Hungaria (BMSK investment)
notes: Origo (2016-12): foundation stone laid for MVM NET Zrt.'s internationally certified datacenter in God (Pest county), next to a MAVIR substation, completion planned 2017 Q3; bitport reported a new government datacenter planned in Budapest and God. atlatszo.hu (2022-01) reports the government datacenter building in God still stood unfinished after ~5 years despite billions in state funds; MVM NET was transferred to Antenna Hungaria in 2022. Current operational status unresolved in public sources - status unknown. Public-sector datacenter.
